title: Digital Skills Bootcamp
description: Free 12-week bootcamp covering data literacy, spreadsheets, and basic programming for job seekers. Suitable for applicants with limited formal education seeking office or remote work.

title: Vocational Training - Skilled Trades
description: Hands-on certification in electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and automotive trades with guaranteed apprenticeship placement. Ideal for applicants preferring practical, high-demand manual professions.

title: Women Returnship Program
description: Supported re-entry into the workforce for women after a career break, including refresher training, mentorship, and part-time placements with partner employers.
target: women, career break, caregivers, large families

title: Small Business & Home Enterprise Grant
description: Micro-grants and business coaching for home-based businesses such as baking, tailoring, and handicrafts. Includes licensing support and access to online marketplaces.

title: Career Counseling & Job Placement
description: One-on-one career counseling, CV building, interview coaching, and direct referral to a network of employers actively hiring entry and mid-level staff.

title: Financial Literacy & Debt Management
description: Workshops on budgeting, saving, and managing debt and credit. Recommended for applicants with high liabilities or low credit scores to improve long-term financial stability.
target: high liabilities, low credit score, over-indebted

title: IT & Cybersecurity Certification
description: Subsidized certifications (CompTIA, networking, cybersecurity fundamentals) leading to well-paid technology roles. Suited to applicants with a diploma or degree seeking higher income.

title: Healthcare Support Worker Training
description: Accredited training for nursing assistants, caregivers, and health support roles with high employment demand and immediate placement pathways.

title: Youth Employment Fast-Track
description: Accelerated placement program for young applicants (under 30) combining a short skills module with a paid 6-month traineeship at partner companies.

title: Remote Work Enablement
description: Training and equipment stipend to enable remote and freelance work for applicants with mobility constraints, disabilities, or caregiving responsibilities.

title: Language & Communication Skills
description: Business English and Arabic communication courses to improve employability in customer-facing and administrative roles.

title: Entrepreneurship Incubator
description: Six-month incubator with seed funding, workspace, and mentoring for scalable startup ideas. For applicants with a viable business plan and growth ambition.
target: self_employed, business plan, growth, higher education
